item.title: Columbia’s Faculty Senate approves C-minus policy change
item.description: The Faculty Senate voted unanimously Friday, Jan. 16, to allow C-minus grades to count toward undergraduate major requirements, a policy change aimed at reducing delayed graduations and unexpected costs for students.
